import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/labels.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading datasets...")
df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

print("Preprocessing features...")


def engineer_features(data):
    data["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(data["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)
    data["hour"] = data["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    data["dayofweek"] = data["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek

    data["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * data["hour"] / 24)
    data["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * data["hour"] / 24)
    data["dow_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * data["dayofweek"] / 7)
    data["dow_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * data["dayofweek"] / 7)

    # Standardize passenger count to typical taxi range
    data["passenger_count"] = data["passenger_count"].clip(1, 6)

    p_lat = np.radians(data["pickup_latitude"])
    p_lon = np.radians(data["pickup_longitude"])
    d_lat = np.radians(data["dropoff_latitude"])
    d_lon = np.radians(data["dropoff_longitude"])

    delta_lat = d_lat - p_lat
    delta_lon = d_lon - p_lon

    a = (
        np.sin(delta_lat / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(p_lat) * np.cos(d_lat) * np.sin(delta_lon / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    data["haversine_dist_km"] = 6371 * c
    return data


df = engineer_features(df)
test = engineer_features(test)

feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour_sin",
    "hour_cos",
    "dow_sin",
    "dow_cos",
    "haversine_dist_km",
]

print("Filtering outliers...")
valid_mask = (
    (df["pickup_latitude"].between(40.5, 41.2))
    & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(-74.5, -73.0))
    & (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(40.5, 41.2))
    & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(-74.5, -73.0))
    & (df["fare_amount"] > 2.5)
    & (df["fare_amount"] < 50.0)
    & (df["haversine_dist_km"] > 0.1)
    & (df["haversine_dist_km"] < 25.0)
)
df_clean = df[valid_mask].copy()
print(f"Rows retained after filtering: {len(df_clean)} out of {len(df)}")

print("Temporal train/validation split...")
df_clean = df_clean.sort_values("pickup_datetime")
split_point = int(len(df_clean) * 0.9)
train_df = df_clean.iloc[:split_point]
val_df = df_clean.iloc[split_point:]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df["fare_amount"]
X_val = val_df[feature_cols]
y_val = val_df["fare_amount"]

X_test = test[feature_cols]

print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=7,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=64,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    min_child_samples=200,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
print(f"Hold-out Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

print("Generating predictions for test set...")
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": sample_sub["key"], "fare_amount": y_test_pred})
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
